couldntLoad: Couldn't load inventory — check the gateway and reload.
intro: Enable or disable {noun} per host. A column per machine; click a cell to toggle that item on that host. "—" means not installed there; "?" means the host was unreachable.
clusterPluginsHelp: Enable plugins for the cluster. The same choice applies wherever a plugin is installed.
pluginRestart: Saved for the cluster. Restart services to apply the change. Offline machines will use it on their next start.
